    print(structure)
    
    # Preview data

    preview = pd.read_sql_query(query_preview, conn)
    print(f"\nFirst 5 rows of '{table_name}':")
    print(preview)
    
    # Distinguish column types
    if not preview.empty:
        print(f"\nColumn types in '{table_name}':")
        numeric_cols = preview.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
        categorical_cols = preview.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns.tolist()
        datetime_cols = preview.select_dtypes(include=['datetime64']).columns.tolist()

import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Connect to the SQLite database
db_path = '/absolute/path/to/your/database.db'  # Replace with your actual path
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Get table names
query_tables = "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
tables = pd.read_sql_query(query_tables, conn)
print("Tables in the database:")
print(tables)

# Inspect structure of each table
for table_name in tables['name']:
    print(f"\nStructure of table '{table_name}':")
    query_structure = f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name});"
    structure = pd.read_sql_query(query_structure, conn)
    print(structure)
    
    # Preview data
    query_preview = f"SELECT * FROM {table_name} LIMIT 5;"
    preview = pd.read_sql_query(query_preview, conn)
    print(f"\nFirst 5 rows of '{table_name}':")
    print(preview)
    
    # Distinguish column types
    if not preview.empty:
        print(f"\nColumn types in '{table_name}':")
        numeric_cols = preview.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
        categorical_cols = preview.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns.tolist()
        datetime_cols = preview.select_dtypes(include=['datetime64']).columns.tolist()
        other_cols = preview.select_dtypes(exclude=[np.number, 'object', 'datetime64']).columns.tolist()
        
        print(f"Numeric columns: {numeric_cols}")
        print(f"Categorical columns: {categorical_cols}")
        print(f"Datetime columns: {datetime_cols}")
        print(f"Other columns: {other_cols}")

conn.close()
